evals.expected_output: A private GitHub repo 'logsift' created from the template, cloned locally, zero <FILL IN> markers, docs/design-system.md and docs/components.md removed (no UI), docs/auth-and-sessions.md removed (no auth), AGENTS.md commands populated with the Python stack (pytest/ruff/mypy), hooks 28/28, CI green.

assertions.text: Zero '<FILL IN' markers remain anywhere in the repo
AGENTS.md test command is pytest, not the npm placeholder
docs/design-system.md and docs/components.md are absent (no UI)

evals.prompt: Spin up a new public repo for a Next.js dashboard with user login. Call it pulseboard.
evals.expected_output: A public repo 'pulseboard' from the template with the node-ts stack wired, design-system.md and components.md RETAINED and populated (has UI), auth-and-sessions.md RETAINED (has auth), and the user offered the Claude Design path before falling back to manual tokens.

assertions.text: docs/design-system.md retained AND contains real token values, not placeholders
